verdict.rationale: GitLab's own docs describe an interactive REST API reference where you can browse and test every endpoint. Its interactive request tool sends live requests with Bearer/OAuth authentication and shows the curl command, the full URL and the server response. The reference is backed by an autogenerated OpenAPI 3.0 spec, which also gives AI-native consumers a raw machine-readable artifact. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the interactive tool works as documented.
